example_phrases: We’re excited to announce a significant enhancement
Databricks pioneered the open data lakehouse architecture
Unlock the predictive power of your time series data
Revolutionizing how enterprises harness their unstructured knowledge base

structure.opening_style: context-setting via industry trends or customer challenges followed by a solution announcement
structure.section_organization: logical progression: Problem/Context -> The Solution (Feature) -> Technical Deep Dive/How-It-Works -> Customer Proof/Benchmark -> Conclusion
structure.code_integration: inline code blocks used as functional proof points, often introduced with phrases like 'Simply write the SQL query below'
structure.conclusion_style: forward-looking summary with direct calls-to-action (links to docs, 'get started', or 'stay tuned')

communication.value_proposition: combining the openness of data lakes with the reliability and performance of data warehouses (Lakehouse), emphasizing cost reduction (TCO) and speed
credibility_markers: Customer quotes (e.g., Corning, Xcel Energy, Tealium)
References to open source contributions (Spark, MLflow)
communication.technical_depth: deep but accessible; bridges high-level business value with low-level implementation details (SQL/Python)

openings: Our customers continue to shift from monolithic prompts with general-purpose models to specialized agent systems to achieve the quality needed to drive ROI with generative AI.

We’re excited to announce that materialized views (MVs) and streaming tables (STs) are now Generally Available in Databricks SQL on AWS and Azure.
